rationale: Build directly on the current 9x512 recurrent-tail QK baseline, but narrow the closest recent anchor idea to the one recurrent pass that has been the most reliable locally: the deepest repeated tail block. Earlier-tail interventions and curricula have been mixed, while learned first-pass anchoring was a close miss. This version adds a tiny learned first-pass anchor only to the final recurrent block, keeps the earlier recurrent block on the proven token-embedding anchor, preserves the exact quant-aware/endgame path, stays compile-stable, and adds only one extra FP32 control vector.
title: Final-Block-Only First-Pass Anchor On Recurrent Tail
